features: ADC data captured through IOB DDR registers at a selectable 2.5 ns stage per core, against the write clock edge the core is encoded on (fixes the garbled A/B cores near multi-bit code boundaries of 0x1537..0x1539, at every sample rate)

capture self-check: outlier counters per core (read 0x36), stage and B-reference register 0x63, threshold 0x64
0x53 bits 3/4 inert; legacy data 4 words (200 MSa/s) / 3 words later than 0x1539, EXT not delayed
bitstreams.bench: flashed 2026-10-20 10:03 (pre-write dump = 0x1539, verified); benched 10-20 10:04-10:49 on fw 0.2.79..0.2.82: the wizard trains the capture stages (this unit 0x08E3: CH1 A3 B4, CH2 A3 B4; the power-on 0x08E4 was bad for CH1 A at two codes), then the dcoffset sweep over codes 109..135 at 200 / 100 / 50 / 20 MSa/s is clean on every core (no rails, no jumps, max std 1.0 / 1.5 / 3.6 / 2.5 at 200 MSa/s) and the self-check flagged 0 of 18865 captures; the 0x64 threshold must be 32 (fw 0.2.80+: 8 sits under CH2's 3-code noise at 5 V/div); the fault of 0x1535..0x1539 is gone. Needs fw 0.2.81+ for the training (older firmware runs the power-on stages, which can be wrong per unit). Built 2026-10-19 22:19 (fpga-gen9); tb 11 steps pass incl. tb_adccap (AD9288 transition model, pad delay sweep, all rates); capture margins >= 1.33 ns at the power-on stages at TT (fpga/al3/README.md section 10); not flashed; bench checks 1..7 of section 10

features: as 0x153A

a record that ends on the auto time-out or on the firmware's forced stop (0x1A = 0 after the ring has wrapped) reports 0x14 = W - total + pretrigger, W the address after the last word written, so the record read from 0x14 - pretrigger is the newest total words, contiguous (0x1532..0x153A reported pretrigger: ring 0 .. total - 1, spliced when the stop fell inside)
the time-out ends only an untriggered capture: a trigger before it completes its post-trigger words (0x0E = total with a trigger gave a cut record)
no trigger is accepted after the stop: 0x18 describes the record
0x1A synchronised into the write clock domain; trigger_address and trigger_read_address frozen with the write enable
bitstreams.bench: built 2026-10-20 13:50 (fpga-gen11, build b2: clk_200MHz 0 errors, min period 4.583 ns; sample_write_clock 9.231 ns; capture margins >= 1.10 ns at the power-on stages at TT, train the stages after flashing as for 0x153A); tb: tb_timeout 75 checks 0 errors at 2048 words (the 0x153A source fails 30 of them: the bench splice), ext / decim / trigpos / firstrec / contract pass, the full 13-step run ALL PASS on seeds 12345 and 4242 (fpga-gen12, 2026-10-20: the two steps fpga-gen11 left not green were testbench artefacts, fpga/al3/AGENTS.md '0x153B flash-ready'); source unchanged since the build; flashed 2026-10-20 19:31 (verified 1391978c..; pre-write backup = the 0x153A padded image, rollback = write it back); the bench of 19:52 (docs/hardware-status.md) read every record as spliced, but the saved records hold no signal at all (code 128 +- 1 on both channels, 1 kHz fundamental under 0.1 code where the square gives about 113; the probes were off the post after the wizard's open-input run; README section 11 'Bench 2026-10-20 19:31-20:03', fpga-gen13), so nothing about the record geometry was measured; tb_timeout case B (fpga-gen13) models that host capture byte for byte and passes; benched 2026-10-20 20:40 on fw 0.2.102 with the probes on (check 0: 181 / 168 codes pk-pk): check 1 the seam test 0 of 100 untriggered captures spliced (50 at 1 MSa/s, 50 at 200 MSa/s), check 2 bode_cells auto records leak -58..-62 dB worst, check 4 ten sweeps 100 Hz..1 MHz / 25 with 25 captures, 0 time-outs, 0 retakes, 0 flagged, check 5 eleven flat 0.5 Hz records at 10 MSa/s none flagged triggered; check 3 (20:49) 50 of the UI's own auto-mode traces in RUN with the level at 255 (READ_TRACE, 50 distinct captures) contiguous, worst seam ratio 0.01, a stopped frame clean on screen; check 6 segments in auto mode (4 x 1024 samples, 10 kHz) untriggered and triggered all contiguous; the 20:40 observation of 3 of 50 untriggered captures reading triggered=1 did not reproduce in 160 captures at levels 255 and 240 with the generator on and off; recommended since 2026-10-20 20:42, 0x153A supported; supported since 2026-10-22 (0x153D recommended): firmware 0.2.103 runs only on 0x153B, 0.2.104 and later show the mismatch banner on it

features: as 0x153B
trigger types pulse width / Nth edge / timeout on CH1, CH2 and EXT (0x5E, 0x5F, 0x60, reads 0x34 / 0x37) and the trigger hold-off on 0x1B (0x66 clears it at the next arm)
peak detect: { max, min } words of the window's raw samples on the 16-bit path, the one-register switch 0x56 bit 1 (0x29 byte 1)
hardware counter with min / max: 0x61 gate / source, 0x62 level / hysteresis, read 0x35 (16 bytes from one snapshot)

cruft of the stock design removed (one-bitstream rule): write 0x3C / read 0x41, reads 0x24..0x27, write 0x0F, 0x53 bits 4..2 (0x29 bits 4..2 read 0); the sample-rate divider is taken on 20 bits (0x0D bits 31..20 ignored)
capability bits the firmware derives from the version word: 2 HOLDOFF, 20 TRIG_TYPES, 21 PEAK_DETECT, 22 COUNTER

the counter is exact with the ADCs at full rate (a filter or 200 MSa/s: 1 kHz 999.996 Hz .. 1 MHz 1000000.000 Hz) and not valid with Filter Off at divided rates (the encodes are gated there; fw 0.2.105 marks such gates GATED); features: as 0x153C

the ADC encodes as on 0x153C: gated by the sample-rate divider with the filter off (K = 0) at D > 0, full rate with any filter, with peak detect and at D = 0 (the full-rate encodes of the first 0x153D build, 0e2cdbce, were reverted after the 2026-10-22 bench: CH2 code errors from the AD9288's partner-core coupling at every timebase)

streaming logger: 0x69 stream / clear lap, 0x6A reader position, read 0x38 (8-byte snapshot: write address, words written, unread words, lap flag); the capture never stops and never triggers while streaming

accurate fractional square generator in place of Atlan4's DDS: 0x6C entries 0 (high) and 1 (low) with u32 + u16/65536 clock durations, 0x6D mode 3 / 0 with commit (double-buffered, glitch-free and phase-continuous changes), start and the idle level, read 0x39; 0x51 / 0x52 retired; every edge within one 5 ns clock of ideal, the mean period exact

the pulse pattern generator, bursts, marker trigger source and pattern trigger engine of the fpga-d2 branch (0x6E, 0x6F, 0x76-0x7D, read 0x42, 0x15 = 3) are not in this bitstream (the owner's cut of 2026-10-21): writes to those codes are ignored, 0x15 = 3 acts as EXT
capability bits the firmware derives from the version word: 2 HOLDOFF, 20 TRIG_TYPES, 21 PEAK_DETECT, 22 COUNTER, 23 LOGGER, 1 GENERATOR (the square)
bitstreams.bench: built 2026-10-22 (fpga-d3gate, roll h1 e3a23c2: clk_200MHz 0 errors at 4.983 ns, every clock closed, 6429 LUT / 7449 LE = 86.2 %, encode pads and capture margins equal to 0x153C's build within 0.03 ns); tb/run.sh 18 steps ALL PASS on seeds 12345 and 4242; flashed 2026-10-22 17:01 (pre-write = the 0x153C padded image 07393bf5.., verified and read back independently aa252fb7..); benched 17:03-19:02 on fw 0.2.105 (docs/hardware-status.md): the wizard with the inputs open trained CH1 A3 B4, CH2 A3 B3 (0x06E3); CH2 code errors (share of samples 4+ codes above a 3-sample median, Filter Off, 1 kHz square from the post through an RC ladder, 16 captures per core) at 2 MSa/s 0 % on both cores, as 0x153C; at 200 MSa/s core A 3.32 %, B 0.37 % (0x153C on 2026-10-22 11:36: A 1.01 %, B 0.86 %, not like-for-like: the share depends on where the offset parks the square's flat levels); per 8-code band CH2 A 12.0 % at 0x58..0x5F (just below the 0x5F/0x60 carry, where the square's low level sat) and <= 0.29 % elsewhere; a scan of CH2 A's capture stages found none better than the trained 3 (2.82 %); the owner accepted this build for 0.3.0 at 18:56; counter on CH1 1 kHz: Filter Off at 200 MSa/s 999.996 Hz valid, Filter Off at 500 kSa/s and 1 MSa/s not valid (GATED, by design), decimation filter mode 3 at 500 kSa/s 1000.004 Hz valid; 301 s soak (status, health, captures) 0 errors; fw 0.2.105 c681efa4 persisted to the card 19:52; recommended since 2026-10-22 18:56. The streaming logger (1 ch 8-bit 500 kS/s, 1 ch 16-bit 250 kS/s, 2 ch 16-bit 125 kS/s, 0 words lost) and roll mode were benched on the first 0x153D build (0e2cdbce, full-rate encodes, 2026-10-22 08:47-09:02), whose logger and square logic this build keeps unchanged; not repeated on this build; encode-phase bench session 2026-11-04 (rel-1 / rel-2, docs/hardware-status.md 09:4x-11:14, fpga/al3/README.md section 19): same image, CH2 sweep peak core A 6.94 % / core B 0.66 %; supported since 2026-11-04 (0x153E is the 0.3.0 bitstream): benched good with fw 0.2.105, release 0.3.0 shows the mismatch banner on it

features: as 0x153D

the four ADC encode pins driven by IOB output registers (AL_LOGIC_ODDR) on PLL C2 (B, 0 degrees) and C3 (A, 375 ps later): the encode pad delay is the same in every placement (B 6.97 / A 7.34 ns, TD typical corner), where 0x153D's fabric flops moved 6.9 .. 7.9 ns from build to build; the encode sequence, every register and every other path as in 0x153D (the fpga-encphase enc0 recipe, benched 2026-11-04 with the 0x153D word)
the 0x33 encode self-check reads the fabric copies of the encodes (same D, same clock edges as the ODDRs), not the pins
capability bits as 0x153D
bitstreams.bench: built 2026-11-04 (fpga-153e, roll i2 da645d0: every clock 0 errors, clk_200MHz 4.802 ns, 6439 LUT / 5912 reg / 7454 LE = 86.3 %, #oreg 15, encode pads B 6.97 / A 7.34 ns on both chips; a fresh rebuild of the committed source gives the same bytes); tb/run.sh 18 steps on seeds 12345 and 4242: ALL PASS on both seeds, every step, no exception; flashed 2026-11-06 14:00-14:04 (pre-write = the 0x153D padded image aa252fb7..; the first pass failed its verify with one lost sector erase and one wrong byte, the second pass verified, independent double read back 2782e1b6..); benched 14:05-15:50 on fw 0.2.105 b278bc0c (main e242b53, built for 0x153E; docs/hardware-status.md): no mismatch notice; the wizard with the inputs open trained CH1 A3 B3, CH2 A3 B3 (0x06DB) cold and again warm; encode self-check 0 bad of 110232, capture self-check 0 flagged of 107674; CH2 code errors (Filter Off, 1 kHz square from the post through an RC ladder, samples 4+ codes above a 3-sample median): 0 % on both cores at 2 MSa/s; at 200 MSa/s the peak over the CH2 offset sweep (tools/enc_sweep.py: the square's low level moved across the 0x5F/0x60 carry in 0.25-code steps) A 5.17 % / 5.12 %, B 0.61 % / 0.65 % with the warm calibration 80 min after power-on (0x153D on 2026-11-04: 6.94 % / 0.66 %), and A 15.1 % / B 2.7 % 10 min after power-on: the share falls about 2.5 times as the unit warms up, so the sweep counts only 30 min or more after power-on; counter on CH1 1 kHz 1000.002 Hz valid at 200 MSa/s, GATED (not valid, by design) with Filter Off at 500 kSa/s; logger 1 ch RAW8 500 kS/s, 1 ch 16-bit 250 kS/s, 2 ch 16-bit 125 kS/s, 5 s each, 0 words lost; fw persisted to the card 15:23 and booted from it 15:49 (no notice, the trained stages in effect); accepted by the owner for 0.3.0 at 15:1x; recommended since 2026-11-06
